findings.claim: 10-K 自述：產業高度分散，進入障礙低，任何具足夠財力與技術的組織都可能成為競爭者；部分對手管理費用較低、報價較低，競標壓力可能壓低價格與利潤率。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: In addition, relatively few barriers exist to prevent entry into most of the industries in which we operate. As a result, any organization that has adequate financial resources, and access to technical expertise, may become a competitor.

findings.claim: 10-K 列出電氣／機械承包主要對手：APi、Comfort Systems、Dycom、Everus、IES、MasTec、MYR、Quanta、Tutor Perini；多數營收來自競標案，邀標常以過往經驗、技術能力與財務實力為條件。
findings.excerpt: A majority of our revenues are derived from projects requiring competitive bids; however, an invitation to bid is often conditioned upon prior experience, technical capability, and financial strength.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出收購競爭：其他潛在收購方可能資源更多或條件更優，可能限制 EME 的併購機會。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We may also face increased competition from other potential acquirers, including those who may have greater financial resources available to them or who may be in a position to offer more favorable terms to the target company.

findings.claim: Zacks/Nasdaq：EMCOR 預期 2026 年成長再度優於美國非住宅營建，並提到創紀錄積壓訂單與持續贏得份額。
findings.source: Nasdaq/Zacks: Can EMCOR Outgrow Nonresidential Construction Again in 2026?

findings.claim: CSIMarket：同業 Comfort Systems 2026 Q2 營收成長 50.26%，市占上升。

note: 搜尋未找到具名新進入者或明確份額百分比；同業 Comfort Systems 營收成長更快（CSIMarket 稱 FIX Q2 2026 營收+50.26%），Zacks 稱 EME 持續贏份額，皆為二手聚合，未取得逐字原文，列為線索。 線索 2 條，程式核實 0 條，2 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
